events: final dealt source-recipient results emit normalized damage.dealt events
state_reads: first strike, double strike, trample, deathtouch, and lifelink
timing: assignment and dealing are turn-based actions that do not use the stack
no priority window occurs between assignment and dealing
assignments are announced in APNAP order before any damage is dealt
damage and resulting state-action triggers are combined before priority
first strike and double strike create two real damage steps with priority after each
targets: unblocked attackers use their current attacked object or player
blocked attackers may assign to current blockers, with ordinary trample spill after lethal assignment
blockers may assign only to attackers they currently block
choices: a controller divides a positive-power source's full damage among currently legal recipients
the complete per-player assignment is validated atomically
forced assignments are derived without issuing a strategic decision
hidden_information: combat assignments contain public battlefield and player references only
apnap: players with assigning creatures announce in APNAP order
earlier announcements are public to later assigning players
represented damage and resulting state-action triggers share one APNAP/controller-order batch
layers: effective power is read through the shared derived-characteristics path
replacement_effects: the complete simultaneous replacement/prevention event batch remains blocked
copy: copies use their effective combat characteristics
control_change: only combat sources currently controlled by the responding seat may be assigned
zone_change: a source or recipient no longer on the battlefield is not a current combat participant
source_leaves: a departed source assigns no combat damage

variants: unblocked attacker dealing damage to a planeswalker or Battle
departed planeswalker receiving no combat damage while its attacker remains blockable
first strike and double strike step eligibility
ordinary trample with marked damage, deathtouch, prevention, and departed blockers
combat lifelink based on damage actually dealt

implementation.component: CommanderEngine APNAP combat assignment, typed damage-event, trigger-batch, and damage application paths

known_blockers: trample over planeswalkers, banding assignment control, and complete combat assignment exceptions are not implemented
lifelink outside the combat damage path and source last-known information are incomplete
a blocker blocking several attackers is not produced by the declaration system
simultaneous damage replacement and prevention require the universal typed event pipeline
trigger-on-trigger two-part placement and complete triggered-ability choice grammar remain CR 603 dependencies
